## What does this improve for a user?

Describe the documentation problem and the proposed correction. Link a related issue if available.

## Evidence

State the app/build or current guide that supports the change. Do not include private app code or personal exports.

## Checks

- [ ] The instructions match the current app or clearly identify a limitation.
- [ ] I checked links and exact screen/control labels.
- [ ] I included no personal, medical, payment, credential, or private project information.
- [ ] I have the right to share this material publicly.
- [ ] I understand maintainers incorporate approved changes into the canonical support documentation before publishing.

For a security vulnerability, stop and use the private reporting route in SECURITY.md.
